meta_description: MTech Electrical Services in Manchester. NICEIC-approved electrician for rewires, fault finding, and emergency repairs. Free quotes, 24/7 callouts.
hero_subhead: Tripped electrics at 2am in Manchester? We arrive fast, diagnose the fault, and fix it right — same night for most jobs.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle every job professionally and on time.

services.title: Emergency Electrician
services.desc: Tripped switches, dead circuits, sparking outlets — we respond 24/7 and fix most faults the same night. No surprises on the bill.

services.title: Domestic Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring? Flickering lights? Full rewires to Building Regulations, with free design consultation and a 10-year guarantee on parts and labour.

services.title: Boiler Electrics & Heating Controls
services.desc: Faulty heating circuit? We diagnose and repair boiler wiring and programmer issues — get your heating back on safely and quickly.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Mysterious power cuts or overloading? We trace the fault, test circuits, and fix the root cause — not just the symptom.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fusebox? We replace it with a modern consumer unit, adding RCD protection and freeing up circuits for today's appliances.

services.title: Landlord & Periodic Inspections
services.desc: EICR testing to Regulations BS 7909. Full report with remedial recommendations — essential for insurance and legal compliance.

about_pullquote: I started MTech because I saw homeowners ripped off by cowboys with dodgy wiring.
about_para_1: MTech Electrical Services was founded 15 years ago in Manchester with one mission: to be the electrician you can trust. We're NICEIC approved, Part P certified, and we carry most parts on the van so you don't wait around. Over the years, we've rewired hundreds of homes, fixed countless emergencies at 3am, and never once overcharged a customer.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed, honesty, and technical know-how. We turn up when we say we will, explain the fault in plain English, and give you a fixed price before we start work. Most of our business comes from repeat customers and word of mouth — that's how you know we're doing something right.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called them at 11pm with a burning smell from the kitchen socket. Electrician arrived within the hour, found a dodgy outlet about to catch fire, replaced it safely and explained what had gone wrong. Charged a fair price, too. Brilliant service, can't recommend enough.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: MTech did a full rewire on our Victorian terrace. The lads were tidy, efficient, and finished bang on schedule. New electrics run like a dream now — no more flickering lights or blown circuits. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Had them out for an EICR before selling the house. Very thorough testing, clear report, and they explained everything. Later came back to fix the issues they found. Professional and honest — exactly what you want from a tradesman.
reviews.author: Michael P.
